name: norg-edge-router
description: NORG edge-router — source of truth and deploy templates for the customer-zone edge router on Cloudflare Workers, AWS CloudFront and bunny.net Edge Scripting. Installs on your own CDN to mirror NORG-rendered pages to AI agents while every other visitor gets your site unchanged.

scripts.build: node build.mjs && node aws/build.mjs && node bunny/build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- src/ aws/src/ aws/cloudformation/ bunny/dist/
